description: This Java source file defines the MissingThingIdsException class, a specific exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate missing thing IDs when requesting multipleThings. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException, providing error codes, HTTP status, and JSON parsing capabilities. It also includes a nested builder class for creating instances.

classes.name: MissingThingIdsException
classes.description: An exception indicating that the list of thing IDs was missing in a request. It contains error code, status code, message, description, and supports JSON deserialization and custom header setting.

classes.description: A builder class with a fluent API to construct instances of MissingThingIdsException, supporting customization of headers, message, description, cause, and href.
